vault_lines: Then there was Dolla, Lil Snupe, triple X, and Mac Dre
meaning:
Mac Dre (Born Andre Louis Hicks) was a rapper and a hypeman from Oakland, California, who was gunned down on November 1, 2004.
He was credited as the creator of the Hyphy Movement. His most famous album is “Thizzelle Washington”

vault_lines: Then there was Dolla, Lil Snupe, triple X, and Mac Dre
meaning: XXXTENTACION a.k.a Triple X (Born Jahseh Dwayne Ricardo Onfroy) was a very influential rapper from Plantation, Florida who got gunned down on June 18, 2018. He is most famous for his songs “Look At Me!” and “Jocelyn Flores”.

vault_lines: Then there was Dolla, Lil Snupe, triple X, and Mac Dre
meaning:
Lil Snupe (Born Addaren Ross) was a rapper from Winnfield, Louisiana, Who got gunned down on June 20, 2013.
He was signed to Meek Mill label, Dreamchasers.
He was most famous for the song “Melo” and for his long freestyles with Meek Mill on YouTube.

vault_lines: Then there was Dolla, Lil Snupe, triple X, and Mac Dre

Dolla (Born Roderick Anthony Burton II) was a rapper from Atlanta, Georgia
He got gunned down on May 18, 2009.

T.I. Wanted to Sign Dolla to his own label
For more information on him visit RipDolla.net.
